content:
The HWPX generation failed because the required severity string 'High (즉시조치)' was missing from the XML sections.
The verifier failed in test_overview_values_and_actions_are_present with an AssertionError. Specifically, the combined content of section0.xml and section1.xml did not contain the expected string 'High (즉시조치)'. While 3 tests passed, the output failed to correctly map and embed the '위험등급' (Risk Level) into the HWPML XML structure as required by the severity_map.
